what: Chrom's neutral attack (Attack11) donor material: the Falchion article (model + motion) for all eight costumes, plus the donor body skeleton and params
why: Chrom's jab on the G&W-skinned Pyra c06/c07 (see projects/pgwr/PLAN_CHROM_JAB.md). The Falchion is a rigid article with no pose clips, so its blade follows the body bone - the opposite of the Aegis esword, which owns its pose and could not be re-aimed by any body clip (graveyard R-20/R-21).

source.plugin: libarc_network.nro on the SD, Smash running, port 43022

arc_paths.model: fighter/chrom/model/sword/c00..c07/ - 14 files each: model.numdlb, model.numshb, model.numshexb, model.nusktb, model.nusrcmdlb, model.nuhlpb, model.numatb, model.xmb, dark_model.numatb, light_model.numatb, metamon_model.numatb, met_chrom_001_col.nutexb, met_chrom_001_nor.nutexb, met_chrom_001_prm.nutexb
arc_paths.motion: fighter/chrom/motion/sword/c00..c07/ - 3 files each: motion_list.bin, j00entryl.nuanmb, j00entryr.nuanmb

layout: refs/chrom_jab/arc/<arc path>, mirroring the ARC tree
hashes: per-file sha256 and byte counts in refs/chrom_jab/extraction.json; re-verify with toolchains/py312/python.exe tools/fetch_arc_files.py --check

not_dumped.sound: sound/bank/fighter/se_chrom.* (27 entries in the ARC index, none extracted). The project convention is to play the recipient's own SE (se_eflame_swing_s01), so the donor bank is only needed if Chrom's own swing sound is wanted.
not_dumped.trail: not needed - dumps/arc/effect/fighter/chrom/ already holds ef_chrom.eff and trail/tex_chrom_sword{1,2}.nutexb, the pair Chrom's AFTER_IMAGE4_ON_arg29 names.

notes: The article skeleton is 2 bones (HaveR root -> Sword); the single mesh fal_RShape is skinned to Sword.
Blade runs along +z with the tip at z = 10.908, against the Aegis blade's 11.39.
Every one of the 20 distinct sword file names is byte-identical across all eight costumes, unlike gamewatch normal_weapon and breath.
